postconditions.description: The number of pairs with 0 ones, 1 one, and 2 ones are non-negative.
At least one of the counts is greater than 0.

postconditions.expression: all(n_i >= 0 for n_i in [n_0, n_1, n_2])
postconditions.description: The counts of pairs are non-negative.
At least one of the counts is positive.

postconditions.expression: exists(s for s in binary_strings if count_ones(s) == [n_0, n_1, n_2])
postconditions.description: There exists a binary string s such that the number of pairs with 0 ones, 1 one, and 2 ones are equal to n_0, n_1, and n_2 respectively.
